payload.docs_match: Docs complete and matching. se.guidance-worktrees teaches the lane as built - milestone commits, the split, the tag first, the refusal rule, the installed toolchain, and push-with-tags. Five ADRs and one law carry the why once each. Eight RAID entries carry what is unsolved, including the one honest limit on this iteration's own claim (the archive is listable at the file level, but no reader resolves it yet - i5e). No surface teaches the superseded close.
payload.packaged: Versioned on the rolling pre-1.0 baseline (quackitect@2.0.0-bootstrap); configuration baselined with the path dependency removed, which is itself the enforcement of the new law; entry script unchanged, recorded as a skip. The one install-relevant change is that a provisioned worktree installs its own toolchain rather than linking a shared one.
payload.dependencies_ruled: Ship review done. The kb path dependency is REMOVED - it was a redundant second mechanism and the one that destroyed the imported repository; the module is still an import, resolved read-only by path. typescript and @types/node unchanged and undiverged. Nothing ships diverged. The owner's new sticky ruling - an import is read-only, whatever the mechanism - is minted and mechanically enforced, so later ships inherit it without being asked. The owner pushes, and the standing message is that the push must now carry tags.
payload.handover_accepted:
This bless is the acceptance, self-blessed as the agent under the owner's explicit delegation for this unattended run: channel chat-grant, adjudicated_by agent, stamped delegated_via se.decision-delegated-adjudication. Six gates were self-blessed this iteration and three earlier ones were not needed.

THE ONE THING THE OWNER SHOULD KNOW BEFORE READING THE RESULT, stated plainly rather than discovered later: this iteration cannot honestly demonstrate its own change on its own ship. The running engine is trunk's, which predates i5d, so blessing this gate closes the iteration under the PRE-SPLIT engine. The close will therefore be driven deliberately from the built code as a recorded bootstrap step - the same shape i5b recorded when it ran on trunk - and the FIRST HONEST DEMONSTRATION of the split is the next iteration's close, not this one. That is registered as se.raid-engine-iteration-cannot-self-demonstrate so nobody later mistakes a bootstrap-driven close for a self-demonstration.
